response.justification: The candidate lacks demonstrated experience in agentic AI systems at scale, fintech infrastructure, or regulated financial environments, with no evidence of multi-agent architecture, real-time credit/risk systems, or leadership scaling engineering teams beyond 10 people — all core requirements for this CTO role.
strengths: Strong full-stack engineering background with diverse tech exposure
Active open-source contributions and tooling development
Proven ability to ship complex systems across domains (GIS, automation, real-time data)
concerns: No evidence of production multi-agent AI systems or LLM orchestration at scale
Lacks fintech domain experience (credit risk, working capital, compliance)
No leadership track record managing 30+ person engineering teams or governing hybrid outsourcing models
